levels.surface: الحسين بن ثوير بن أبي فاختة

notes: «حدثني أبي» : bare «أبي» with no name is a relation, kept with «علي بن الحسين» and «محمد بن الحسن» as one level («جميعا» joins them at the next name)

The report turns into a first-person scene: Husayn ibn Thuwayr says he sat «عند أبي عبد الله (ع)» and the Imam speaks inside it; «عند» is a place (rule 6), and whether the Imam is the last link or only in the scene is not settled, so he is not added
